title: Completed integral constant realization and stratified local models
statement: For a scheme T [def-pc-scheme] and an adic coefficient datum A [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], let A_T be the actual completed coefficient sheaf. Define the constant-module realization by constant module sheafification, scalar extension to A_T, and transport along the normalized completed coefficient isomorphism. Its derived functor is the realization of complexes in [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define local restriction by derived inverse image and slice restriction [def-weil-pbc-ringed-site-derived-restriction]. A complex is stratified perfect if some finite stratification [def-constructible-stratification] has covering sieves on which it is the realization of perfect algebra complexes [def-pc-perfect-ring-complex]. A sheaf is stratified finitely presented if on such local covers it is the ordinary realization of finitely presented algebra modules [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Bounded constructible cohomology means global upper and lower cohomology bounds and this sheaf condition in every degree.
